title: Open your eyes now. I will. One moment. Has all vanished since? If I open and am for ever in the black adiaphane.
html_source: Again, back to playing with the modality of sight and being while being without sight– This functions more to voice an irrational and intellectualized fear (does reality exist if the subject cannot see it) and to suspend or collapse the moment before the eyes are opened.
